adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_county_dossiers_desc: People must not have to explain their circumstances afresh at every office. We will survey administrative districts in Manchuria. Ownership and full control of the relevant territory are required; losing either cancels the focus. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_payroll_registers_desc: The office must be open when residents arrive. We will establish Manchurian Public Services I. It applies only while we own and fully control the territory, and does not transfer to other regions or owners. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_service_counters_desc: We will bridge the gap between documents said to have been sent and offices that say they never arrived. Research will support communications and the operation of facilities. This can be pursued before or after the other parallel policy. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_dispute_records_desc: Two offices are responsible for the supplies, yet neither delivers them where they are needed. Combining public services and communications will see requests from residents and requisitions through to completion. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_service_calendar_desc: The office's promises must survive a change of officials. Public Services will advance to tier II, unlocking a 90-day project costing 150 Political Power. Restarting the project after regaining the territory restores the higher-tier institution. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_interpreter_desks_desc: We will listen to residents before asking for their seals. Multilingual offices will open. Ownership and full control of the relevant territory are required; losing either cancels the focus. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_residence_certificates_desc: A new address does not mean that someone has settled in. We will establish Manchurian Community Support I. It applies only while we own and fully control the territory, and does not transfer to other regions or owners. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_municipal_consultation_desc: We will ask whom clinic guidance and school notices actually reach. Research will support the operation of health and education facilities. This can be pursued before or after the other parallel policy. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_shared_service_manuals_desc: People should receive the same guidance at every office. We will bring together working standards for settlement support, health and education in an established joint administration agreement. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_community_mediation_desc: People must still have somewhere to ask for help after receiving assistance. Community Support will advance to tier II, unlocking a 90-day project costing 150 Political Power. Restarting the project after regaining the territory restores the higher-tier institution. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_workshop_inventory_desc: We will check whether the machinery listed in the accounts actually works. Manchuria's equipment and raw materials will be surveyed. Ownership and full control of the relevant territory are required; losing either cancels the focus. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$, $STATE_714$, $STATE_944$, $STATE_945$, $STATE_717$, $STATE_942$, $STATE_943$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_metallurgical_trials_desc: Before discarding anything, we will see whether it can serve as raw material again. We will establish Manchurian Materials Recovery I. It applies only while we own and fully control the territory, and does not transfer to other regions or owners. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$, $STATE_714$, $STATE_944$, $STATE_945$, $STATE_717$, $STATE_942$, $STATE_943$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_material_recovery_desc: What a mineral can be used for matters more than its name. Research will support sorting trials and the practical use of technology. This can be pursued before or after the other parallel policy. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$, $STATE_714$, $STATE_944$, $STATE_945$, $STATE_717$, $STATE_942$, $STATE_943$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_foundry_batches_desc: Smelting workers who have used recovered materials will compare their records with the technicians conducting sorting trials. The two will pool their findings, sharing successful mixtures and failed processes alike. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$, $STATE_714$, $STATE_944$, $STATE_945$, $STATE_717$, $STATE_942$, $STATE_943$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_integrated_recovery_desc: Recovered materials must not pile up in warehouses once more. Materials Recovery will advance to tier II, unlocking a 90-day project costing 150 Political Power. Restarting the project after regaining the territory restores the higher-tier institution. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$, $STATE_714$, $STATE_944$, $STATE_945$, $STATE_717$, $STATE_942$, $STATE_943$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_tenancy_records_desc: An address on record does not make a house habitable. We will survey housing and repair needs in Gungnae. Ownership and full control of the relevant territory are required; losing either cancels the focus. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_sanitation_rounds_desc: The roads and drains outside a home are part of daily life as well. We will establish Gungnae Urban Management I. It applies only while we own and fully control the territory, and does not transfer to other regions or owners. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_housing_repairs_desc: If the same roof leaks again, sending more materials is not enough. Research will support repair techniques and the operation of facilities. This can be pursued before or after the other parallel policy. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_market_inspections_desc: Someone must take responsibility for the problems between homes and markets as well. We will combine urban management and repair experience to improve sanitation on the streets residents use every day. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_settled_municipality_desc: We will build a city that works without special instructions. Urban Management will advance to tier II, unlocking a 90-day project costing 150 Political Power. Restarting the project after regaining the territory restores the higher-tier institution. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_local_services_project_desc:
"It is not that the goods are missing. No one has decided where to receive them."
Offices send requisitions back to warehouses, warehouses send them on to other offices, and supplies wait for transport. We will assign receiving officials and destinations, and coordinate warehouse and railway schedules so that administrative requests lead to actual deliveries.

Costs 150 Political Power and provides an intensive administration and transport effect for 90 days from the start. Restores Manchurian Public Services II if previously acquired and subsequently removed. The tier II institution remains after the 90-day project ends if its own conditions are still met. Occupies no civilian factories. Only one Manchurian administrative project may run at a time; all four share a 90-day waiting period after completion or cancellation. Cancelled if continuing requirements, including ownership and full control of the target territory, are lost, or in the event of capitulation or civil war. Costs are not refunded. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_community_services_project_de: Residents should not have to explain the same circumstances again at every office. We will align intake and handover procedures between multilingual offices and local institutions so that guidance from the office that verified a resident's address is also recognised by schools and clinics. Settlement support will help people with a new address find the assistance they need for daily life as well.\n\nCosts 150 Political Power and provides an intensive settlement support effect for 90 days from the start. Restores Manchurian Community Support II if previously acquired and subsequently removed. The tier II institution remains after the 90-day project ends if its own conditions are still met. Occupies no civilian factories. Only one Manchurian administrative project may run at a time; all four share a 90-day waiting period after completion or cancellation. Requires a democratic government and ownership and full control of the target territory. Cancelled if these conditions are lost, or in the event of capitulation or civil war. Costs are not refunded. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_material_recovery_project_des: We will connect shortages of raw materials with stocks of recovered goods. If recovered materials remain mixed together in warehouses, smelters can do little but wait for fresh supplies. Sorting records will be matched to smelters' requirements, with intensive support for handovers and transport to get reusable materials to the processes that need them.\n\nCosts 150 Political Power and provides an intensive materials recovery effect for 90 days from the start. Restores Manchurian Materials Recovery II in the relevant states if previously acquired and subsequently removed. The tier II institution remains after the 90-day project ends if its own conditions are still met. Occupies no civilian factories. Only one Manchurian administrative project may run at a time; all four share a 90-day waiting period after completion or cancellation. Losing ownership or full control of even one target state cancels the entire project, as does loss of other continuing requirements, capitulation or civil war. Costs are not refunded. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$, $STATE_714$, $STATE_944$, $STATE_945$, $STATE_717$, $STATE_942$, $STATE_943$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.HOK_KOR_mc_municipal_routine_project_des: We will begin by reducing the need to dig up the road just after repairing a house. When deliveries of housing repair materials clash with road and drainage work, residents and workers are left waiting at the same blocked street. We will review Gungnae's housing and construction records together, coordinating material deliveries with infrastructure maintenance so that work across the city does not get in its own way.\n\nCosts 150 Political Power and provides an intensive housing and facilities repair effect for 90 days from the start. Restores Gungnae Urban Management II if previously acquired and subsequently removed. The tier II institution remains after the 90-day project ends if its own conditions are still met. Occupies no civilian factories. Only one Manchurian administrative project may run at a time; all four share a 90-day waiting period after completion or cancellation. Cancelled if continuing requirements, including ownership and full control of the target territory, are lost, or in the event of capitulation or civil war. Costs are not refunded. Target states: $STATE_328$, $STATE_941$. All target states must be owned and fully controlled.
adapted_values.RAGNAROK_ENABLED_TEXT_DESC:
Korea is locked into the democratic Kim Gu route to prevent early conquests of France or Italy. On 1 January 1938, every other country in the world will unite in a single faction and declare war on Korea.

§RWarning!§! Hearts of Korea Extreme: RagnaROK is intended for experienced players seeking a tougher challenge. For an even harder game, select Elite difficulty and strengthen every country except Korea.
adapted_values.hokRagnarok.7.d: Led by Britain, the nations of the world have united in a single front to bring down the Republic of Korea. There is nowhere left to retreat.
adapted_values.hokRagnarok.7.a: Come at us, all of you.
